name: Linwick
fantasy: The flue sweep. Hoses foes down with fire until they blaze, rams them head first, and hits back harder after every knock.
silhouette: the tall sooty top hat and the bellows on the back

card.loop: Close-range burner: soak foes in fire until they blaze, then finish them in the flames.

weapons.flamethrower: Hold to hose fire 7m ahead; the stream trails behind a sweep and hits harder on a burning foe.

card.rmb: Hold to aim, release: a cinder that lands at your cursor and spreads the burn.
card.e: A ring flashes, then a blast of heat drags nearby foes in and wraps you in a fire shield.
card.dash: Ram head first toward the cursor; you stop on the first foe with a fiery hit. 2 charges.
card.passive: Flashover: your fire sets foes Ablaze, then Flashes them over. A knock heals you and readies the cloak.
card.x: Ultimate (X, level 6): fly toward the cursor and steer, laying a lava carpet that slows and burns; X again lands.

passive.name: Flashover
passive.desc: Your fire builds Char on foes (it all falls off after 5s). At 31 Char the foe is Ablaze: 3s of burning for 2% of their health a second, one flame over their head. Fed again to full Char they Flash over: a fiercer burn (4%), three flames and a glow. Anything that stokes a foe already burning upgrades it. A knock heals you 16% of your health.

dash.name: Soot Ram
dash.desc: A short head-first dash (up to 4.4m) toward the cursor that stops on the first foe: 16 damage, a shove (you bounce back a little) and 17 Char (half a Flashover). Two charges. A knock restores one charge only.

variants.tap: Hold to aim down a lane, release: a cinder that lands at your cursor (14m at most): 14 damage and it sets the foe Ablaze. On a foe that is already burning it upgrades the burn and spreads the burn to foes within 4m. A miss fizzles at the cursor.

e.name: Furnace Cloak
e.desc: A thin ring flashes at 4.5m for 0.2s, then a blast of heat: 7 damage, 16 Char and Anti-Heal for 3s, and foes in sight are dragged toward you (walls stop them). Hit anyone and you wear a swirling 3s shield of 6.4% health plus 5.1% per foe. A knock resets it.

x.name: Flue Flight
x.desc: Lift off in a ring of embers and fly 1.4s toward the cursor, steering as you aim (up to 120 degrees a second). A 1.8m lava carpet forms under you and lasts 4s: 4.5 damage a second, a 30% slow, and 4 Char every 0.3s (Ablaze in about 2.4s). Press X again to land early. The Furnace Cloak works mid-flight and a knockback speeds you up. The carpet never forms over the abyss. 32s.

rank3.dash: stokes the foe: upgrades their burn at once
rank3.sec: hitting refunds 25% of the cooldown and +60% damage
rank3.kin: +50% damage and shield; stoking refunds 25% of the cooldown

rank_next.sec: Rank 3: cooldown 7s -> 4.6s, damage +50%; refunds 25% of the cooldown when it stokes.
rank_next.dash: Rank 3: recharge 9s -> 7.8s; stokes the foe at once.
rank_next.kin: Rank 3: cooldown 10.5s -> 6.5s, damage and shield +50%; refunds 25% of the cooldown when it stokes.

tells.half: embers drift off a foe at half Char; one flame over a foe Ablaze
tells.full: three flames and a glow over a foe that Flashed over
